questions.text: Read the rollercoaster text and choose A or B for each statement.

context.text:
A: Expedition GeForce is at Holiday Park in Hassloch, Germany. It is 53 metres high in places, making it one of the tallest rides in Europe. It is in a forest, has a 1.2 km track, takes 75 seconds and reaches 120 km/h.

B: Takabisha is at Fuji-Q Highland Amusement Park in Japan. Its one-kilometre ride takes just under two minutes, reaches 110 km/h, and halfway through the track goes down at an angle of more than 120 degrees. Mount Fuji can be seen from it.

matching_pairs.left: is near a very high place
is described as one of the tallest rides in Europe

questions.explanation: A is in a forest, reaches 120 km/h and is described as one of Europe's tallest rides. B is near Mount Fuji and has a steep drop halfway through.
